## Overview

This week introduces AI governance: what it is, how it differs from technical AI safety, and why it matters now. Then it covers the main risks governance has to address: **misuse**, **loss of control**, and **concentration of power**. That gives you the vocabulary for the rest of the module. Next week turns to the actors who shape AI governance.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this week, you can:

- Explain what AI governance is and how it differs from technical AI safety
- Explain why AI governance matters now
- Describe the main risks AI governance has to address: misuse, loss of control, and concentration of power

The [discussion session](discussions.qmd#week-1) asks how governance and technical safety depend on each other, and whether the public can see enough inside AI labs to judge the risks.
